title: Target-Specific De Novo Drug Design via Fine-Tuned Language Models and Molecular Docking, Molecular Dynamics Simulation Validation
one_liner_zh: 该文用微调语言模型从蛋白序列生成配体SELFIES，并结合分子对接和MD验证，虽以配体设计为核心，但涉及蛋白-配体结构相互作用计算，算法框架对蛋白结构相关计算有借鉴意义。
abstract: De novo drug design remains an expensive and low-yield process, particularly for targets with limited bioactivity data. In this study, we fine-tuned the Qwen 2.5 0.5B model to treat ligand design as a sequence-to-sequence task from protein amino acid sequences to molecular SELFIES representations. A curated and balanced dataset derived from ChEMBL was used to reduce target-level data imbalance, followed by systematic evaluation using beam search and stochastic sampling. The fine-tuned model demonstrated strong ligand generation capability across multiple targets, achieving high validity, uniqueness, and novelty. Comparative analysis revealed that beam search favored conservative exploitation of learned chemical space, whereas sampling enabled broader exploration and higher novelty. Molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, and MM/PBSA binding free-energy calculations for representative targets showed that generated compounds formed stable complexes with energetically favorable binding profiles comparable to known inhibitors. Notably, target-specific fine-tuning under extreme low data conditions, enabled through molecular representation augmentation, successfully guided ligand generation toward relevant structural frameworks. Our work suggests that small language models can be effectively fine-tuned for structure-aware, target-specific ligand design, even under limited bioactivity information.
abstract_zh: 从头设计药物仍然是一个昂贵且低产出的过程，尤其是对于生物活性数据有限的目标靶点。在本研究中，我们对Qwen 2.5 0.5B模型进行了微调，将配体设计视为从蛋白质氨基酸序列到分子SELFIES表示的序列到序列任务。使用源自ChEMBL的精选且平衡的数据集来减少靶点层面的数据不平衡，随后通过束搜索和随机采样进行系统评估。微调后的模型在多个靶点上展现出强大的配体生成能力，实现了高有效性、独特性和新颖性。比较分析显示，束搜索倾向于对已学习化学空间进行保守性利用，而采样则能够实现更广泛的探索和更高的新颖性。针对代表性靶点的分子对接、分子动力学模拟以及MM/PBSA结合自由能计算表明，生成的化合物形成了稳定的复合物，其结合特征在能量上有利，与已知抑制剂相当。值得注意的是，在极端低数据条件下，通过分子表示增强实现的靶点特异性微调，成功引导了配体生成朝向相关的结构框架。我们的工作表明，即使生物活性信息有限，小型语言模型也能被有效微调用于结构感知的、靶点特异性的配体设计。
